position_on: the key's own pole: raising the minimum wage and protecting workers, including the right to unionize
confidence_reason: Two of his own campaign pages commit him to a $15 federal minimum wage, wider overtime and the PRO Act, and his own 2025 post backs striking hotel workers; held at 0.85 because the record rests on campaign messaging, not a federal record.

sources.note: Read directly on 2026-11-25 (the page's full text, as published on his campaign site). His “Labor & Business” platform page. The paid-leave record cites a different line from this page.
